note: VALUE OR MESSAGE, asked as a value so the answer is comparable. `count-matches' takes an INTERACTIVE argument and messages `N matches' only when it is non-nil; called from Lisp it RETURNS the count and messages nothing, so Emacs answers (2 integer t nil). A kg implementation that reported through the echo area and returned nil would fail here rather than pass silently. kg answered `void-function' before 26.2; it answers (2 integer t nil) now, and honours INTERACTIVE by messaging when it is non-nil rather than by ignoring it.
